en.tagline: Generate and edit images with 50+ AI models via one CLI
en.summary: This skill runs AI image generation, editing, inpainting, and upscaling through the inference.sh `belt` CLI. It covers models such as GPT-Image-2.6, FLUX, Gemini, Grok, Seedream, and Reve from one command interface. It is meant for art, mockups, social graphics, and marketing visuals.
problem: Image models differ in their app IDs, inputs, and strengths, so trying several of them means learning several interfaces. This skill gives one command pattern for all of them: `belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`.

With the skill, you pick a model from the table by its use case, pass a text prompt or image URLs as JSON, and get the result from the CLI. Text rendering, LoRA styles, and upscaling are covered by named models in the same table.
fit: Generating product photos, concept art, or illustrations from a text prompt
Editing an existing image with a text instruction or changing its background
Making social media or marketing graphics that need readable text in the image
Upscaling an image with the Topaz Upscaler
unfit: Video generation, which has its own skill listed under related skills
Background removal or AI avatar videos, which are separate skills
Work that cannot use the inference.sh CLI or a belt login
steps: Log in once with `belt login`, after the belt CLI is set up.
Choose a model from the table by its best-for use, such as GPT-Image-2.6 Flare for general editing or FLUX Dev LoRA for custom styles.
Run the model with `belt app run <app-id> --input '{"prompt": "..."}'`, adding fields such as `quality` or `aspect_ratio` where the model supports them.
For edits, pass one or more image URLs in the `images` field, as shown in the GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst example.
For upscaling, run `falai/topaz-image-upscaler` with an `image` URL.
To list the image apps available to you, run `belt app list --category image`.

zh.tagline: 通过一个 CLI 调用 50 多个 AI 模型生成和编辑图片
zh.summary: 这个技能通过 inference.sh 的 `belt` CLI 完成 AI 图片生成、编辑、局部重绘和放大。它在同一套命令下支持 GPT-Image-2.6、FLUX、Gemini、Grok、Seedream、Reve 等模型。适用于艺术创作、产品效果图、社交媒体图和营销视觉。
problem: 不同图片模型的应用 ID、输入参数和擅长方向各不相同，逐个试用就要学习多套接口。这个技能提供统一的命令格式：`belt app run <app-id> --input '<json>'`。
使用该技能后，你可以按用途从表格中选模型，用 JSON 传入文字提示词或图片地址，然后在 CLI 中获得结果。文字渲染、LoRA 风格和放大功能都能在同一张表格中找到对应的具名模型。
fit: 根据文字描述生成产品照片、概念图或插画
用文字指令编辑已有图片，或更换图片背景
制作需要图中有清晰文字的社交媒体或营销图
用 Topaz Upscaler 放大图片
unfit: 视频生成，该功能在相关技能中单独列出
抠图或 AI 数字人视频，这些属于其他技能
无法使用 inference.sh CLI 或 `belt login` 的场景
steps: 在设置好 belt CLI 后，运行一次 `belt login` 完成登录。
按擅长用途从表格中选择模型，例如通用编辑选 GPT-Image-2.6 Flare，自定义风格选 FLUX Dev LoRA。
运行 `belt app run <app-id> --input '{"prompt": "..."}'`，模型支持时可加上 `quality` 或 `aspect_ratio` 等字段。
编辑图片时，把一个或多个图片地址放入 `images` 字段，参考 GPT-Image-2.6 Sunburst 的示例。
放大图片时，用 `image` 地址运行 `falai/topaz-image-upscaler`。
运行 `belt app list --category image` 可列出可用的图片应用。
